_note: Plant-model maturity ladder (P6). Each level needs every check of the levels below. Tolerances are FIXED here and the certificate records this file's hash, so a tolerance cannot be loosened to pass (shortcut S1). Method after a simulation-evaluation review: falsifiable spec, hand calculation vs solver, two-point convergence with both values reported, shortcuts named, every failure attributed to MODEL, CHECK or TOOL. AI-assisted, synthetic, illustrative.

attribution.MODEL: the model violates the spec: counts against the model's level
attribution.CHECK: the check itself failed to evaluate (a bug in the check): fix the check, re-run; never counts against the model
attribution.TOOL: omc / compiler / simulation environment failed: the run is BLOCKED, the level is not lowered

levels.name: Validated
levels._note: needs measured data; the vehicle plant has none, so it tops out at L2

tolerances._b2b_note: b2b_rel/b2b_abs fixed on 2026-10-14 BEFORE the first L2 run: per-ms max |python - fmu| <= max(b2b_rel * signal range, b2b_abs). It must absorb the 1 ms dead-time difference D1; it is not widened after seeing results.

shortcuts.shortcut: loosen a tolerance until a check passes
shortcuts.blocked_by: tolerances fixed in this file; its hash is in the certificate

shortcuts.shortcut: report only the fine-tolerance result as 'converged'
shortcuts.blocked_by: the certificate lists BOTH convergence values and their difference per experiment
the model file hash is frozen in the L1 certificate; L2 must run on the same hash
every seeded model mutant must turn at least one L1 check red (mutants.all_caught)

shortcuts.shortcut: count a tool crash as a model failure (or as a pass)
shortcuts.blocked_by: TOOL attribution: the run is BLOCKED, neither pass nor fail
